specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT the supplied existing game ALBEDO PNG in place. Preserve its exact blue-purple palette, relative brightness, SOFT hand-painted rendering, broad blended color planes, rounded painted bevels and composition. The user wants a little asymmetric character, NOT rough distressed damage. Add deliberate sparse local sculptural imperfections and a few small paint-loss patches. Render shallow recesses with a soft violet-blue shadow on one side and a slim soft pale-blue catchlight on the opposite side, not harsh black slashes. Exposed undercoat is muted cool gray-blue, never orange/copper/rust. Keep at least 85% of each panel calm and intact. No overall noise, speckle, grunge layer, heavy flakes, deep cracks, scattered scratches, huge gashes, photoreal wear or impasto. Keep the warm/soft hand-drawn Warcraft/League-field/Hearthstone family style already visible in the image. Opaque square texture ONLY, no text, render scene or presentation board.
This is a flat 4m FLOOR BASE COLOR with FOUR equal square tiles in a 2x2 grid. Lock seams at x=50%,y=50%, existing corner fittings and opposite-image-border continuity. Each of the FOUR tiles MUST have visibly different asymmetry, not a repeated or mirrored stamp. Upper-left tile: ONE short gently bent shallow groove in its upper-left quadrant, about 18% of tile width, offset away from the corner bolt; a small smooth irregular paint-loss patch around a short stretch of its lower edge. Upper-right tile: an uneven shallow crescent-shaped dent just inside its right edge, with a small rubbed patch near the upper-left edge. Lower-left tile: a small offset L-shaped shallow channel near its lower-right quadrant, NOT a perfectly geometric decoration; tiny paint worn off on a short upper-edge segment. Lower-right tile: ONE short tapered recessed scrape, about 20% tile width, angled gently in its upper-right quadrant; a small irregular smooth chip near its left edge. Leave centers predominantly quiet. Give edge chips only 1-3 small grouped irregular shapes per tile, with rounded painterly edges and no flaky jagged microdetail. These are shallow dents and small local coating wear, not large diagonal blade cuts. New details should remain readable at game scale through medium-scale shape design. Exact original 2x2 texture layout; no new panels or subdivision.
A remains calm and relatively dark, low contrast, thin soft highlights; keep its nuanced irregular painted color planes.

This is the actual W01 WALL UV ATLAS. Lock the normalized positions/shapes/orientations/size/count of EVERY existing island and all black gutters/holes. Most important: large clipped-corner front plate in lower-left, narrow pale vertical trim immediately right of it, all small bolts on top/right, and framing bars. Do NOT rearrange UV islands or resize/reinterpret silhouettes. On the large front plate, add ONE short asymmetrical soft shallow bent groove near its upper-left side, and ONE little off-center dent near its lower-right side; a restrained small coating wear patch hugging a short lower-left edge stretch. These three details are different positions, not symmetric. A few selected structural frame islands get a tiny rubbed patch on just one end, some selected small plate islands get ONE soft shallow edge nick on a different side each; most islands remain unchanged. Leave bolt geometry and existing fasteners in place. Use irregular soft-edged cool-gray-blue undercoat patches; no chipped orange primer, no stress-cracks, no surface-wide texture noise. Do not put any decorative frame inside the largest plate, do not add UV pieces, do not change black padding. It must remain the same softly painted industrial panel atlas.
